purpose: Machine-readable candidate list for Project Zero coverage registry. Audit only — not activated. No Scout methodology or schedule changes.
notes: Do not treat this file as authorization to change Scout 01–07 methodologies or Monday/Thursday routines.
Estonia/Tallinn–Tartu is the first acceptance case.

sources.why_it_matters: National ecosystem facilitator with news, events calendar, and Dealroom-backed sector company list—primary structured surface for Estonian startups.
sources.access_limitations: Dashboard/company list is public but Dealroom-derived; some downloads may need form interaction. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Official statistics + downloadable startup company list from Tax Board/Business Register/Dealroom—best structured roster of Estonian startups.
sources.access_limitations: WebFetch timed out once; URL confirmed via WebSearch and site navigation. Data updates quarterly. Verified 2026-09-24 (search).

sources.why_it_matters: Primary TalTech spin-off and IP commercialisation surface with public spin-off stories and technology portfolio pathway.
sources.access_limitations: Spin-off lists and tech portfolio are public; some invention/process docs are intranet-only. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Public listing of licensable/co-founder-ready TalTech technologies—early signal of impending spinouts.
sources.access_limitations: Portfolio updates irregularly; Estonian-language sibling pages may have more detail. Verified via WebSearch 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: University of Tartu IP-for-equity holding company—direct surface for Tartu research spinouts and portfolio companies.
sources.access_limitations: Portfolio page is public but sparse; no structured API. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: National DeepTech Accelerator (up to €170k equity-free) jointly with Sparkup—core early deeptech cohort surface for Tallinn/Tartu.
sources.access_limitations: Cohort announcements public; applicant lists may not be fully published. Next open call noted Oct 2026. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Tartu Science Park side of €12M+ national DeepTech Startup Network linking Uni Tartu/TalTech/EMU to market.
sources.access_limitations: Programme pages public; individual team names often via news only. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Equity-free prototype grants (up to €35k) with public winner announcements—excellent pre-company/pre-seed signal for technical teams.
sources.access_limitations: Application rounds closed between batches; winners listed publicly. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: ESA space/deeptech incubator (€60k equity-free) in Tallinn & Tartu—defence-adjacent and technical early-stage pipeline.
sources.access_limitations: Applications via Dealum; selected cohorts announced in news. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Local DIANA dual-use defence accelerator surface (€100k+) run by Tehnopol/Sparkup—high-value defence deeptech signal.
sources.access_limitations: Selection is via NATO DIANA central process (diana.nato.int); local page explains Estonian delivery. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Official Alliance dual-use challenge calls—primary application surface; Estonian accelerator is a delivery site.
sources.access_limitations: Challenge windows are periodic; company names often published after selection. Verified HEAD 200 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: State VC fund-of-funds (incl. Green and Defence funds)—announcements signal capital formation and fund launches affecting Estonian dealflow.
sources.access_limitations: Invests mostly via funds; direct portfolio visibility limited. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: National enterprise agency hosting innovation loans and growth support that often appear before or alongside first private rounds.
sources.access_limitations: English site thinner than Estonian; grant beneficiary lists may require deeper navigation. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Best-known national startup competition/accelerator with TV exposure—surfaces new founder teams before company maturity.
sources.access_limitations: Seasonal programme; finalists public via ETV/site. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Flagship Tallinn startup/tech conference with pitch competition—concentrated early-stage founder and investor visibility.
sources.access_limitations: Startup attendee lists partly gated to participants/app. Verified 2026-09-24 (May 2026 edition live).

sources.why_it_matters: Largest Tartu entrepreneurship festival (300+ startups)—primary South-Estonia event surface for formations and spinouts.
sources.access_limitations: Full startup database often sent to ticket holders; public site shows speakers/highlights. Verified 2026-09-24.

sources.why_it_matters: Peer founder community surface—useful for talent-exit and serial-founder formation signals when public content is posted.

sources.why_it_matters: Estonian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association—fund launches and LP/GP signals affecting early funding visibility.
